arxiv query 'wearable_fluorescence': abs:wearable AND abs:fluorescence
pubmed query 'carbon_dots_fluorescence_sensor': ("carbon dots"[tiab] OR "carbon quantum dots"[tiab]) AND fluorescen*[tiab] AND (sensor*[tiab] OR sensing[tiab] OR probe*[tiab] OR detection[tiab])
pubmed query 'carbon_dots_bilirubin': ("carbon dots"[tiab] OR "carbon quantum dots"[tiab] OR "carbon dot"[tiab]) AND bilirubin[tiab]
pubmed query 'microneedle_fluorescence': microneedle*[tiab] AND fluorescen*[tiab]
pubmed query 'hydrogel_microneedle': microneedle*[tiab] AND (hydrogel*[tiab] OR GelMA[tiab] OR "gelatin methacryl*"[tiab])
pubmed query 'gelma_microneedle': microneedle*[tiab] AND GelMA[tiab]
pubmed query 'microneedle_sensor': microneedle*[tiab] AND (sensor*[tiab] OR sensing[tiab] OR biosensor*[tiab])
pubmed query 'wearable_fluorescence_reader': wearable[tiab] AND fluorescen*[tiab] AND (reader[tiab] OR smartphone[tiab] OR optoelectronic[tiab] OR device[tiab])
pubmed query 'as7341': AS7341[tiab]
pubmed query 'bilirubin_skin_sensor': bilirubin[tiab] AND (wearable[tiab] OR transcutaneous[tiab] OR skin[tiab]) AND (sensor*[tiab] OR optical[tiab] OR fluorescen*[tiab])
pubmed query 'tattoo_sensor': tattoo[tiab] AND (sensor*[tiab] OR fluorescen*[tiab])
pubmed query 'microneedle_array_patch': microneedle*[tiab] AND (array*[tiab] OR patch*[tiab])

meta.about: Hardware numbers stated in the device's own paper, each with its paper id and exact sentence. Parameters the paper does not state are NOT_FOUND. The literature harvest (official APIs only) is kept for counts: other papers' values are not written until the user asks to 'add typical'.
meta.policy: values only from the device's own paper (coordinator instruction, 15 Nov 2026); NOT_FOUND parameters carry value objects with status NOT_STATED and value null

meta.dedup: by arXiv id, PMID and DOI (case-insensitive); a record found again keeps its first copy
meta.extraction: Text is normalised (LaTeX, Unicode and MEDLINE spellings of units, √Hz, °C, ×, ±, µ) on a copy that maps back to the original, so each quote and sentence is exact (whitespace runs collapsed; a PDF line break keeps its hyphen). A number counts only when its unit and the words next to it name the parameter (RULES in scripts/build_literature.py); bounds such as 'below', 'respectively' lists, areas or volumes where a length is meant, and values outside each parameter's plausible_range are rejected. In the device's own paper both ends of a stated range are kept.
meta.raw_cache: data/literature/raw/ (gzip of the exact response bytes; see raw/manifest.json); not in git (over 20 MB) and not in the public build

values.quote: tattoo sensor recorded at the reader’s 470 nm optical channel, which are wirelessly
values.sentence: In order to quantify and calculate the ISF’s BIL concentration, the FL intensities/analytical signals (S0 and S1) of the tattoo sensor recorded at the reader’s 470 nm optical channel, which are wirelessly transmitted by the reader’s IoT module to a smartphone, are replaced in the equation of y = 35.304x - 26.04, where x is the ISF’s BIL concentration (mg dL-1) and y is the analytical signal (ΔS=(S1-S0)).
